Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you want to know about AI-powered text generation

Does the AI text generator create original content?

Yes! Our AI never copies content from sources. It analyzes information and writes fully original text in its own words, tailored to your guidelines.

What languages does Smart-Copy.AI support?

The AI content generator supports 8 languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Ukrainian and Russian. You can generate content in any of these languages with full grammar and style accuracy.

How long can AI-generated texts be?

Smart-Copy supports texts from 2,000 characters (1 page) to about 300,000 characters (about 150 pages). You can order short product descriptions, long blog articles, ebook content or analytical reports.

Can I add my own source materials?

Yes! You can add up to 6 custom sources (website links or PDF/DOC/DOCX files). The AI content generator will prioritize them, creating text based primarily on your materials.

How much does content generation cost?

The price is $1.08 per 1000 characters. For example: 1 page (2000 characters) = $2.16, 10-page article = $10.81. That's 10x cheaper than traditional copywriting!

Is the content SEO-friendly?

Yes! The AI text generator creates SEO-optimized content - natural keyword usage, proper H1-H3 heading structure, high uniqueness and substantive value.
